answer: Cosignatures are collected in grove, verified in jade, and summit names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 2 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 39 submissions per epoch. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, as a result paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. That is 471 dollars of sunk cost for a share worth less than the deposit itself. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
